# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Hand-assemble the demo ROM
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
asm = """
0200  6A00   VA = 0          ; x position
0202  6C01   VC = 1          ; dx (+1 / -1 as 0xFF)
0204  6B10   VB = 16         ; y position
0206  67FE   V7 = 0xFE       ; xor mask to flip dx
0208  A234   I  = 0x234      ; sprite data
020A  00E0   CLS
020C  DAB6   DXYN VA,VB,6    ; draw ball
020E  6F04   VF = 4
0210  FF15   DT = VF         ; frame pacing
0212  F007   V0 = DT
0214  3000   SE V0,0
0216  1212   JP 0x212        ; wait until timer hits 0
0218  6505   V5 = 5
021A  E59E   SKP V5
021C  1224   JP 0x224        ; key 5 not down
021E  8C73   VC ^= V7        ; reverse direction
0220  6F08   VF = 8
0222  FF18   ST = VF         ; beep
0224  3A00   SE VA,0
0226  122A   JP 0x22A
0228  6C01   VC = 1          ; bounce off left wall
022A  3A3A   SE VA,58
022C  1230   JP 0x230
022E  6CFF   VC = 0xFF       ; bounce off right wall
0230  8AC4   VA += VC
0232  120A   JP 0x20A
0234  3C7EFFFF7E3C           ; 8x6 ball sprite
"""
rom = bytearray()
for line in asm.strip().splitlines():
    line = line.split(';')[0].strip()
    if not line: continue
    parts = line.split()
    addr = int(parts[0], 16)
    data = bytes.fromhex(parts[1])
    assert len(rom) == addr - 0x200, (hex(addr), len(rom))
    rom += data
print("ROM length:", len(rom), "end addr:", hex(0x200+len(rom)))
hexstr = ",".join("0x%02X" % b for b in rom)
print(hexstr)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Reference CHIP-8 interpreter (independent implementation)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
FONT = [0xF0,0x90,0x90,0x90,0xF0, 0x20,0x60,0x20,0x20,0x70, 0xF0,0x10,0xF0,0x80,0xF0,
        0xF0,0x10,0xF0,0x10,0xF0, 0x90,0x90,0xF0,0x10,0x10, 0xF0,0x80,0xF0,0x10,0xF0,
        0xF0,0x80,0xF0,0x90,0xF0, 0xF0,0x10,0x20,0x40,0x40, 0xF0,0x90,0xF0,0x90,0xF0,
        0xF0,0x90,0xF0,0x10,0xF0, 0xF0,0x90,0xF0,0x90,0x90, 0xE0,0x90,0xE0,0x90,0xE0,
        0xF0,0x80,0x80,0x80,0xF0, 0xE0,0x90,0x90,0x90,0xE0, 0xF0,0x80,0xF0,0x80,0xF0,
        0xF0,0x80,0xF0,0x80,0x80]

class Ref:
    def __init__(self, rom):
        self.m = bytearray(4096)
        self.m[0x50:0x50+80] = bytes(FONT)
        self.m[0x200:0x200+len(rom)] = rom
        self.V = [0]*16
        self.I = 0; self.pc = 0x200
        self.stack = []; self.dt = 0; self.st = 0
        self.gfx = [[0]*64 for _ in range(32)]
        self.keys = [False]*16
        self.halted = False
        self.log = []
    def step(self):
        op = (self.m[self.pc] << 8) | self.m[self.pc+1]
        self.pc = (self.pc + 2) & 0xFFF
        n1 = (op>>12)&0xF; x=(op>>8)&0xF; y=(op>>4)&0xF; n=op&0xF; nn=op&0xFF; nnn=op&0xFFF
        V = self.V; m = self.m
        if n1==0:
            if op==0x00E0: self.gfx=[[0]*64 for _ in range(32)]
            elif op==0x00EE:
                assert self.stack, "stack underflow"
                self.pc = self.stack.pop()
            else: raise Exception("unknown 0nnn %03X"%op)
        elif n1==1: self.pc = nnn
        elif n1==2: self.stack.append(self.pc); self.pc = nnn
        elif n1==3:
            if V[x]==nn: self.pc=(self.pc+2)&0xFFF
        elif n1==4:
            if V[x]!=nn: self.pc=(self.pc+2)&0xFFF
        elif n1==5:
            assert n==0
            if V[x]==V[y]: self.pc=(self.pc+2)&0xFFF
        elif n1==6: V[x]=nn
        elif n1==7: V[x]=(V[x]+nn)&0xFF
        elif n1==8:
            if n==0: V[x]=V[y]
            elif n==1: V[x]|=V[y]
            elif n==2: V[x]&=V[y]
            elif n==3: V[x]^=V[y]
            elif n==4:
                s=V[x]+V[y]; V[0xF]=1 if s>255 else 0; V[x]=s&0xFF
            elif n==5:
                b=1 if V[x]>=V[y] else 0; V[x]=(V[x]-V[y])&0xFF; V[0xF]=b
            elif n==6: V[0xF]=V[x]&1; V[x]>>=1
            elif n==7:
                b=1 if V[y]>=V[x] else 0; V[x]=(V[y]-V[x])&0xFF; V[0xF]=b
            elif n==0xE: V[0xF]= (V[x]>>7)&1; V[x]=(V[x]<<1)&0xFF
            else: raise Exception("bad 8xy%X"%n)
        elif n1==9:
            assert n==0
            if V[x]!=V[y]: self.pc=(self.pc+2)&0xFFF
        elif n1==0xA: self.I = nnn
        elif n1==0xB: self.pc = (nnn + V[0]) & 0xFFF
        elif n1==0xC: V[x] = 0x5A & nn   # deterministic fake rand
        elif n1==0xD:
            V[0xF]=0
            for row in range(n):
                sp = m[self.I+row]
                for col in range(8):
                    if sp & (0x80>>col):
                        px=(V[x]+col)%64; py=(V[y]+row)%32
                        if self.gfx[py][px]: V[0xF]=1
                        self.gfx[py][px]^=1
        elif n1==0xE:
            if nn==0x9E:
                if self.keys[V[x]&0xF]: self.pc=(self.pc+2)&0xFFF
            elif nn==0xA1:
                if not self.keys[V[x]&0xF]: self.pc=(self.pc+2)&0xFFF
            else: raise Exception("bad Ex%02X"%nn)
        elif n1==0xF:
            if nn==0x07: V[x]=self.dt
            elif nn==0x0A:
                if any(self.keys):
                    V[x]=self.keys.index(True)
                else: self.pc=(self.pc-2)&0xFFF
            elif nn==0x15: self.dt=V[x]
            elif nn==0x18: self.st=V[x]
            elif nn==0x1E: self.I=(self.I+V[x])&0xFFF
            elif nn==0x29: self.I=0x50+5*(V[x]&0xF)
            elif nn==0x33:
                m[self.I]=V[x]//100; m[self.I+1]=(V[x]//10)%10; m[self.I+2]=V[x]%10
            elif nn==0x55:
                for i in range(x+1): m[self.I+i]=V[i]
            elif nn==0x65:
                for i in range(x+1): V[i]=m[self.I+i]
            else: raise Exception("bad Fx%02X"%nn)
        else: raise Exception("bad op %03X"%op)
        return op
    def tick(self):
        if self.dt: self.dt-=1
        if self.st: self.st-=1

def show(g):
    for r in g:
        print("".join("#" if c else "." for c in r))

cpu = Ref(rom)
# run some frames: 10 cycles per frame, 60Hz
for frame in range(120):
    for _ in range(10):
        cpu.step()
    cpu.tick()
    if frame in (0, 5, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50):
        xs = [c for c in range(64) if any(cpu.gfx[r][c] for r in range(32))]
        print("frame", frame, "VA=%d VC=%d DT=%d ST=%d I=%03X PC=%03X"%(cpu.V[0xA],cpu.V[0xC],cpu.dt,cpu.st,cpu.I,cpu.pc), "x-range", (min(xs),max(xs)) if xs else None)
print("--- display at frame 20 ---")
show(cpu.gfx)
# now press key 5 for a few frames and check direction reverses
before = cpu.V[0xC]
cpu.keys[5]=True
for _ in range(10):
    for _ in range(10): cpu.step()
    cpu.tick()
print("dx before key:", before, "dx after key5:", cpu.V[0xC], "ST after key:", cpu.st)
cpu.keys[5]=False
# run to check bounce off right wall
maxx=0
for _ in range(2000):
    for _ in range(10): cpu.step()
    cpu.tick()
    maxx=max(maxx, cpu.V[0xA])
print("max x reached:", maxx, "(expect 58)")
print("OK: ROM runs, no exceptions")
